title: Information Technology Officer (IIUM on Demand Employment)
job_description:
Possess Bachelor Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology that is recognised by the Government from any local institutions of higher learning or equivalent qualification. Proficiency in English and Bahasa Malaysia, both verbal and written. Possess good interpersonal skills and meticulous personality. Adaptive, innovative independent and self-motivated with possessing good problem-solving skills. Possess high level of integrity. Ability to work in a team, committed and dedicated to work. Knowledge of Database Design and Data Integration. Experience in web application development and system integration. Familiarity with any open-source reporting tools. Familiarity with standard software development methodologies such as agile or waterfall models. Applicants should be a Malaysian citizen. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Technical Support & Helpdesk: Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical assistance to staff and students regarding hardware, software, and network connectivity issues. System Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance on department-specific servers, workstations, and peripherals to ensure 24/7 operational readiness. Network Administration: Assist in the configuration and monitoring of local area networks (LAN), Wi-Fi access points, and VPN services within the IIUM ecosystem. Software Deployment: Install, configure, and update university-approved software and specialized academic applications. Security Compliance: Implement and monitor basic cybersecurity protocols, including antivirus updates, firewall configurations, and data backup procedures. Asset Management: Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets and provide technical specifications for the procurement of new hardware or software. Event Support: Provide on-site technical coordination for university seminars, convocations, and hybrid learning events.
